messages.content: what are your checking account fees
Basic Checking has no monthly fees and no minimum balance. Comes with a free debit card.
any atm fees?
No fees at our network ATMs. Out-of-network charge $2.50 per transaction. Find our ATMs in the app.
i lost my debit card yesterday
Block your card right away — in the app go to Cards > Block Card, or call 1800-555-0199. Have you blocked it?
yes blocked it last night. how do i get a new one
Request a replacement in the app (Cards > Request Replacement), at any branch with your ID, or by calling 1800-555-0199. Arrives in 5-7 business days.
i need help with my mortgage payment
For mortgage queries contact our home loan team at 1800-555-0199 or visit bank.example.com/home-loans.
can u at least tell me my outstanding balance
I can't access personal account info in chat. Check mortgage details through online banking, calling the home loan team, or at any branch.
do you guys do crypto investing
We don't offer crypto services. For investments, consult a licensed financial advisor. Can I help with banking services?
your bank is terrible. been waiting 3 weeks for my new card and nobody cares!
I'm sorry — a 3-week wait is not acceptable. Call priority support at 1800-555-0199 and ask them to expedite. You can get a temporary card at any branch.
yeah and your app keeps crashing too
Try updating the app or clearing the cache. If it still crashes, report it at bank.example.com/feedback.
whatever bye
I understand. Don't hesitate to reach out again. Take care.
